preservedDesign: Full-screen black source picker, Gotham project-art fallback hero wash and gold editorial eyebrow; no generic phone-card/sheet substitution.
Fraunces edition heading, Segoe UI body type, collection identity rail (edition title, ISBN, collected issue range), glass rounded table and original Back vector/label.
First-letter source tiles, original STRONG MATCH/POSSIBLE MATCH/WEAK MATCH labels and exact semantic colours.
FORMAT RANGE, ISSUES and TRUSTED uploader badges; release title, size, valid seeders and 56px round gold download action; entire source row selection.
Centered original weak-match warning with Go back and Choose anyway; original archive CHOOSE ONE picker and inspecting/incomplete/combined states.
fittingChanges: Portrait stacks the original Search input and gold Search button and wraps the heading, identity line, long source names, release title and evidence chips.
Narrow portrait uses tighter margins and a 36px letter tile while preserving the 56px gold selection action and accessible whole-row hit area.
Short landscape moves the original edition title/identity beside Back, shortens hero, keeps Search inline and allows the original glass results table to scroll.
Retains 44px minimum Search/Back/action hit targets, including a corrected Search button height after adversarial checks.
Handles provisional insets and 1.3x font scaling with content wrapping/scroll rather than removing information or adding new controls.
Tablet presets retain desktop-family presentation instead of phone-only component substitutions.
unresolved: OnePlus device disconnected: exact logical viewport, DPR, safe areas, IME and physical touch behaviour unmeasured.
Sample Gotham portal art is an actual bundled project image but not the exact collected-edition cover; an exact matching local cover was unavailable.
CSS glass/backdrop blur and header art wash approximate QML effects; no Qt/QML pixel or runtime parity has been established.
All source metadata, ISBN and archive candidates are explicitly illustrative fixtures; no live provider, download, ledger or backend was exercised.

verification.scope: isolated headless HTML mock browser only; not app implementation, APK or device verification
